title: 第十五章 修炼第十六章 草木洗经一
content_zh:
此时，青山隘城内元帅府中，偌大的客厅里洪元帅一个人正坐在一张宽木大椅上。
靠在椅背上，他仰首望着天板，一双环眼转动不停，一只手缓缓摩挲着下巴，正陷入沉思之中。
“那边侍卫回报说，李言今早已被季文禾叫入室内，想必是正式拜师了，下一步应该就会入门修行了。”
一个声音自大厅一角传来，那里有根一人粗的巨大厅柱，却是空无一人。
仔细看去，才能发现，厅住阴影中有一敦实的壮汉站在那里，身体与柱影重合在了一起。
他身材不高，一身皂袍，如同那根粗壮的厅柱底盘一样堆在那里。
“他昨夜没有让这小子立即拜师，已经让我感到惊讶了，以他现在看似身体越来越差的样子，竟还能如此不疾不徐，倒也是不错了。”
洪元帅也不看那边，双眼依然盯着天板。
“那师兄可能看出他到底是真压制不住体内之毒了，还是装作如此？”
皂袍大汉说道。
上次他那弟子，自从入得军师府后，就再也没出来，很难有机会接触到，仅仅月余就已死于非命。
“昌伯，我这都没先去他们两家，先来你这里，可是有了天大的好消息要说与你听的。”
“他爹，村长今天应该会回来了吧？”
皂袍大汉瓮声瓮气地说道。
自昨日李言走后，家中气氛一直压抑。
昌伯见到李国新，赶紧站定身形，李伟和李小珠也凑上前来，昌伯吸了一气，然后脸露微笑说道。
“师弟，那般做法是我们最后的选择，我现在想是如何从那小子身上入手。
一群娃听了后，在一片“噢，噢……”的欢快声中离开了，有的跑向家中去了，有几个则是跑向旁边同来的几个村民。
“师兄莫要夸大如此，虽然他武功已至化境，但一来他身体之毒需要分不少内力压制。二来我师兄弟二人也在绝顶高手之境停留了十年有余了。
昌伯抬起头来，脸上也是急躁和烦闷，用筷子敲敲碗边，“叮叮”作响。

“哈哈哈……昌伯，我就不进去了，这刚进村马车还拴在前面呢，李玉和李山家都没去，就先来你这了。和你这说完事情，我还得去他俩家报信呢。”
其实他俩也知道，即使问了，爹也一样不知道，只不过觉得就是这没有结果的言语，大家多说说，心里好像也是舒服些的。
“师兄，江湖之中就没有无法修炼的功法，即使是毒功、邪功，只有拿到功法就可以修炼，只有修炼结果高与低罢了，而非能不能修炼。
然后与李伟三人一脸期待的望着李国新。
庄稼人对粮食的感情如同慈母与游子，粒粒皆辛苦，不是那些大老爷可以明白的。
挂上黑木牌关上门，他拉开椅子，坐在了桌前后就拿起小木人，脑中细细地想着“气息引导术”行功路线。
我倒不曾听过内功对人体质有何要求，就拿本门的那些从低等到高深心法来说，若给门下弟子，哪一个又不能修炼？只是修炼速度不同罢了。”
昌伯一家更是呆立当场，不能置信。
“十有八九是真的，无论是那边侍卫平时的消息，还是从他这几年不停寻徒来看，都不像假的。
李言没有选择旁边那间空房作为修炼室，他觉得在自己房间就挺好的。
定睛一看，正是昌伯和他家两个娃，后面还跟着同样急匆的李言娘亲。
content_en:
At this time, in the Marshal's Mansion in Qingshan Pass City, Marshal Hong was sitting alone on a large wooden chair in the huge living room.
Leaning on the back of the chair, he looked up at the ceiling, his eyes moving constantly, and he slowly rubbed his chin with one hand, lost in thought.
"The guards over there reported that Li Yan was called into the room by Ji Wenhe this morning. He must have officially become a disciple. The next step should be to start practicing."
A voice came from the corner of the hall, where there was a huge pillar as thick as a person, but there was no one there.
If you look carefully, you can see that there is a stocky man standing there in the shadow of the hall, his body and the shadow of the pillar overlap.
He was not tall and was wearing a soap robe. He was piled there like the base of a thick hall pillar.
"I was surprised that he didn't ask this boy to become a disciple immediately last night. Considering that his health seems to be getting worse and worse, he can still be so unhurried and unhurried, which is quite good."
Marshal Hong didn't look there either, his eyes still stared at the ceiling.
"Then senior brother may have seen that he really can't suppress the poison in his body, or is he just pretending to be like this?"
The tall man in soap robe said.
His disciple last time never came out since he entered the Military Advisor's Mansion. It was difficult to have a chance to contact him. He died unexpectedly in just over a month.
"Uncle Chang, I didn't even go to their house first. I came to you first, but I have great news to tell you."
"His father, the village chief should be back today, right?"
The tall man in soap robe said angrily.
Since Li Yan left yesterday, the atmosphere at home has been depressing.
When Chang Bo saw Li Guoxin, he quickly stood up. Li Wei and Li Xiaozhu also came forward. Chang Bo took a breath, and then said with a smile on his face.
"Junior brother, that approach is our last choice. Now I am thinking about how to start with that kid.
After hearing this, a group of children left in a cheerful voice of "Oh, oh...". Some ran to their homes, and some ran to the villagers who came with them.
"Senior brother, don't exaggerate. Although his martial arts has reached the state of transformation, the poison in his body needs a lot of internal energy to suppress it. Secondly, my two senior brothers have also stayed in the realm of extreme masters for more than ten years.
Chang Bo raised his head, with a look of impatience and annoyance on his face, and tapped the edge of the bowl with his chopsticks, making a "ding-ding" sound.
"Hahaha... Uncle Chang, I won't go in. The carriage is still tied up in front when we enter the village. Li Yu and Li Shan didn't go to their homes, so they came to your place first. After talking to you, I have to go to their homes to report the news."
In fact, they both knew that even if they asked, Dad still didn't know. He just felt that it was just such fruitless words. If everyone talked about it more, they would feel better.
"Senior brother, there is no martial art that cannot be practiced in the world. Even poisonous and evil arts can be practiced as long as you get the martial arts. The only difference is whether the cultivation result is high or low, not whether you can practice it.
Then the three of them, Li Wei, looked at Li Guoxin expectantly.
Farmers' feelings for food are like those of a loving mother and a wanderer. Every grain of grain is worked hard, which is not something that the great masters can understand.
After hanging the black wooden sign and closing the door, he pulled out his chair, sat down at the table and picked up the wooden figure, carefully thinking about the "Breath Guidance Technique" route in his mind.
I have never heard of the physical requirements of internal energy on the human body. Take the mental methods of our sect ranging from low to advanced. If they were given to my disciples, which one would not be able to practice them? It’s just that the speed of cultivation is different. "
The Chang Bo family stood stunned on the spot, in disbelief.
"Nine times out of ten, it's true. Whether it's the usual news about the guard over there or judging from his constant search for disciples in the past few years, it doesn't seem to be false.
Li Yan did not choose the empty room next to him as his training room. He thought it would be good in his own room.
Taking a closer look, it was Uncle Chang and his two children, followed by Li Yan's mother who was also in a hurry.
